about: P64 T8-R3 second sealed portrait set: 24 English sentences sealed 30. 10. 2026 after the board-genre camera fixes, before anything is shot on them. The first P64 set (../holdout.json) was opened in T8 and the code changed after it, so the gate needs a fresh one. r64-01 to r64-19 = one sentence per genre of GENRES (src/play/genre/contract.ts), in that order, taken from the unused T1 candidate pool (written 28. 10., never shot or judged); r64-20 to r64-24 = five more board-genre sentences, four of them new, for the genres that lost on the first set (timing stack, slice, catch, merge) plus defense. genre = what the quick game's offline classifier picks today (classifyGenre(text, null).ranked[0].genre, no model call); the no-model draft (draftGameSpecWithMeta, seed 1) played the same genre when sealed. Opened once (r3/holdout-opened.json); nothing is tuned on it.

sentences.text: A ski patroller skis down a foggy slope at full speed, swerving around fallen logs and frozen boulders
A tiny robot hops between floating platforms above a pit of bubbling lava
A farm cat chases mischievous mice around a dusty hay barn until sunrise
A teenage witch flies her broom over a sleeping town, weaving past church spires and owls
A lighthouse keeper lights every lantern along a rocky coast before the night ships arrive
A pirate captain aims at enemy ships through the fog with a rusty cannon
A beach kid flings coconuts at crabs stealing towels on a crowded shore
A monk stretches a pole across deep canyons to reach the next mountain temple
A street drummer bangs on pots and pans to the beat as the city wakes up
An old sheriff faces a masked outlaw in a high noon showdown on a dusty main street
A little dragon rises up through a narrow canyon dodging icicles hanging from the walls
A garden gnome scoops up cherries dropping from an old tree into his little cap
A lunch lady bops slimy frogs popping out of the drains of a school cafeteria
Slimy snails crawl toward the vegetable garden every night and a brave hedgehog holds them back
A kung fu master slashes clay pots hurled at him across a temple courtyard
A raccoon family crosses six lanes of night traffic to raid the diner dumpsters
A swarm of rubber ducks multiplies as it floats through bonus gates down a waterslide
A robot merges identical bolts into bigger gears on a junkyard conveyor belt
A stubborn goat rams pushy sheep out of a muddy hay ring at the county fair
A crane operator lowers shipping containers onto a wobbling stack at a windy harbor without letting it topple
A ninja chef slices flying pumpkins hurled across a moonlit rooftop with twin cleavers
A kid in a raincoat collects raindrops dropping from a leaky roof in a teacup
A candy maker combines matching gumdrops into giant lollipops on a sticky factory tray
A castle maid keeps the goblins from breaking into the royal kitchen with a broom
